column7: Builds the per-answer cap a live HTTP backend's body is read under: the backend's max_frame_bytes as the one limit; a wrong or swapped limit would let an oversized answer be held whole.
Stores the backend's max_frame_bytes on its HTTP transport; if it were never called a raised or lowered limit would be ignored and the 16 MiB default would apply.
Reads the per-answer limit each body read is capped at.

Chooses the budget every HTTP answer body is read under: the preview's kept budget where set, else a fresh one at the transport's limit; a mistake would read live answers unbounded or keep one refusal for every later answer.
Decodes a streamed answer while holding only the event being assembled, bounded by the backend's per-answer limit; a wrong bound would hold an oversized event whole or refuse a legal one.
